activity.notes: Muhammad Ahmad launched the Mahdist movement in 1881, but the user specifically supplied the Mahdist State. ATLAS therefore begins the state-specific Activity with the fall of Khartoum on 26 January 1885 and closes it with Muhammad Ahmad's death at Omdurman on 22 June 1885. His earlier 1881-1884 revolutionary leadership is not conflated with formal control of the Mahdist State.

sources.title: Mahdist State — Encyclopedia.com
sources.citation_text: The encyclopedia describes the independent Mahdist government as established in January 1885 by Muhammad Ahmad and records his death on 22 June 1885.

sources.title: Mahommed Ahmed ibn Seyyid Abdullah — Encyclopaedia Britannica 1911
sources.citation_text: The Britannica article records the capture of Khartoum on 25-26 January 1885 and Muhammad Ahmad's death on 22 June 1885.
